## What?

Describe the behavior that changes.

## Why?

Explain the engineering goal and why it helps the user.

## How?

Call out only the design decisions a reviewer needs.

## Testing

Name the tests added, commands run and actual results. State untested cases, their likelihood and risk.

## Screenshots

For UI changes, add before/after captures. For backend changes, show a short CLI result.

## Anything else?

List dependencies, follow-ups or release limits.
